verdict.rationale: Fivetran's REST API and MCP server let you manage connections, transformations, and account settings programmatically, and docs explicitly say the API lets you 'set up and scale your data pipeline, and manage your Fivetran account programmatically' (fivetran-docs-3, fivetran-docs-22). However there's no evidence of full UI-API parity claim, no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (404s), and MCP read/write/delete scopes are gated/opt-in rather than default full coverage. missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, discoverable OpenAPI/schema, evidence that every UI feature (e.g. dashboard configs, alerts, RBAC settings) is API-accessible.
